availability.note: Single grade 'Omoda 9 SHS-P Virtue AWD MY27' live on the configurator with a price; CarExpert and CarsGuide 2027 pages also list one variant (MY27 released 2 Sept 2026)

listPrice.note: Configurator tile 'From $58,990*' (data-price 58990.00). Unlike every Jaecoo tile it is not labelled 'driveaway', and the same tile carries Omoda's own per-state drive-away estimates ('Driveaway price includes all on-road costs') of VIC $66,696.30, NSW $66,477.20, NT $64,052.20, WA $68,395.20 - so $58,990 is the pre-on-road base, not a national drive-away; the J7 'MSRP = DAP - $2,000' relation does not apply. No expiry stated (only the $1,000 gift card to 30/11/2026 and 1.88% finance to 30/11/2026). App Vic drive-away at $58,990 = $62,347.58; Omoda's VIC estimate is $4,349 higher (implies a ~$4.2k dealer delivery, high). Sources disagree: CarExpert MY27 variant page, CarsGuide 2027 price page (MSRP) and EV Central (updated 21/11/2026) all still say $61,990 before on-road costs (launch RRP, GoAuto 2025 '$61,990 plus on-road costs'); at $61,990 Omoda's VIC estimate would sit $1,222 above the app's $65,473.58. Owner convention: prefer the manufacturer's own price

batteryKwh.note: 34.46 (NMC) on the Spanish ficha for the same 395kW AWD SHS variant; also '34.46 kWh M3P battery' on Omoda UK news page and CompleteCar. AU spec sheet rounds to 34 kWh. Gross/usable not stated anywhere found; treated as usable, as on siblings chery-tiggo-9-phev-ultimate and jaecoo-j8-shs (34.5)

rangeKm.note: Spanish ficha 'HEV Equivalent All electric range combined 145 km' on 245/50 R20 as the AU car; Omoda UK '90 miles' (= 145 km) on 20in. AU spec sheet 169 km is NEDC (ADR 81/02) and higher than WLTP: rejected per direction test. AutoTrader NZ real test 116 km to 20% SoC

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 34.46/145 = 23.77. Not used: AU 193 Wh/km (NEDC ADR label) and ES/carwow '181 Wh/km' (WLTP combined electric consumption, quantity unclear). AutoTrader NZ observed ~21 kWh/100km

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: CompleteCar: 'more likely figure on 7.0 litres/100km with a depleted battery'. No published WLTP charge-sustaining figure found (Omoda UK page gives none for SHS-P). Corroboration: AutoTrader NZ trip computer 6.9 expressway / 6.0 town with battery depleted; km77 120km/h motorway loop 8.2. Siblings sit lower (jaecoo-j8-shs 6.6, chery-tiggo-9-phev-ultimate 6.3) on the same 34.5 kWh SHS powertrain

combinedRangeKm.note: 145 WLTP + 70 L tank (AU spec sheet 'Fuel Tank Capacity 70L') / 7.0 x 100 = 1145

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: AU spec sheet 'Fuel Consumption - Combined (L/100km) 1.4' (NEDC, ADR 81/02) <= 3.5

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green passenger car: combined tailpipe CO2 <= 120 g/km; AU spec sheet 'CO2 Emissions - Combined 32' g/km

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: '471 litros hasta las ventanas con asientos montados' (to the window line, = cargo-cover convention), same PHEV variant so battery fitted; same figure on carwow.es ('medicion propia del fabricante'). AU spec sheet gives only 'Luggage Capacity - VDA Up to Roof 660'; AutoTrader NZ confirms 660 is to the roof

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Spanish ficha '1.004 litros' seats folded, labelled 'hasta el techo' - but AU spec sheet gives '2nd Row Seats Folded, Measured Up to Roof 1,783', so the 1,004 is read as the below-roof (belt-line) figure the owner convention asks for; label conflict unresolved. Sibling jaecoo-j7-shs uses a to-roof folded figure

towKg.note: 'Maximum Towing Mass - Braked Trailer 1,500', non-braked 750, towball 75

warrantyYears.note: 8 years/unlimited km from first registration, conditional only on servicing per manufacturer guidelines (not dealer-only); no shorter private fallback (150,000 km cap only for commercial use); HV battery same terms, <70% net capacity covered

insuranceAnnual.note: Anchored to jaecoo-j8-shs-summit and chery-tiggo-9-phev-ultimate (both 1950 at $59,990, same 34.5 kWh SHS powertrain); +50 for the 395kW/4.9s performance claim. Unchanged from held row

depreciationCurve.note: Omoda/Jaecoo brand convention (jaecoo-j7-shs, jaecoo-j8-shs, chery-tiggo-9-phev); evidence: advertised price reset from $61,990 launch RRP to $58,990 within ~15 months, rolling gift-card and 1.88% finance campaigns on the configurator, young brand with unproven resale

lowConfidence: omoda-9-shs-virtue.listPrice: $58,990 from Omoda's configurator, read as pre-on-road because Omoda's own per-state drive-away estimates sit $5-9k above it; CarExpert, CarsGuide and EV Central still say $61,990 before on-roads, and it may be a campaign base with no stated expiry
omoda-9-shs-virtue.bootLitresSeatsDown: 1,004 L from a Spanish ficha labelled 'to the roof' that conflicts with the AU 1,783 L to-roof figure; read as the belt-line figure
omoda-9-shs-virtue.bootLitresSeatsUp: 471 L to the window line from Spanish ficha (motor.es/carwow.es, likely one shared database); no Australian to-cover figure published
omoda-9-shs-virtue.fuelConsumptionL100km: 7.0 is a review estimate (CompleteCar), not a published charge-sustaining figure; siblings on the same powertrain carry 6.3-6.6
